<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<addon id="plugin.video.xtreammate"
       name="XCMate"
       version="0.1.29.95"
       provider-name="GS Media">

  <requires>
    <import addon="xbmc.python" version="3.0.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.pil" version="5.1.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.requests" version="2.27.0" optional="true"/>

</requires>

  <extension point="xbmc.python.pluginsource" library="default.py">
    <provides>video audio</provides>
  </extension>

  <extension point="xbmc.service" library="service.py" start="startup"/>

  <extension point="xbmc.addon.metadata">
    <summary lang="en_GB">XCMate – TV setup wizard for Xtream, M3U and Stalker</summary>
    <summary lang="de_DE">XCMate – IPTV-Einrichtungsassistent mit Xtream, M3U und Stalker</summary>
    <description lang="en_GB">
      Independent GPL-licensed derivative of mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi, featuring a guided IPTV import process and on-video remote-control live channel and category navigation.
      Features: Multiple M3U playlists, Xtream Codes API (Live/VOD/Series),
      XMLTV EPG, channel groups, favourites, search, catch-up, recordings,
      reminders, sleep timer.
    </description>
    <description lang="de_DE">
      Eigenständiger GPL-Fork von mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi mit geführter IPTV-Einrichtung und Fernbedienungssteuerung über laufendem Live-TV.
      Funktionen: Mehrere M3U-Playlists, Xtream-Codes-API (Live/VOD/Serien),
      XMLTV-EPG, Sendergruppen, Favoriten, Suche, Catch-up, Aufnahmen,
      Erinnerungen, Sleep-Timer.
    </description>
    <platform>all</platform>
    <license>GPL-2.0-only</license>
    <defaultlanguage>resource.language.en_gb</defaultlanguage>
    <forum>https://forum.kodi.tv</forum>
    <website>https://kodi.tv</website>
    <source>https://github.com/artattakk-creator/kodi-noodleprivate</source>
    <news>0.1.29.91 Release Candidate: Sechs beschriftete BINGIE-Reihen: Filme, Serien, Im Kino, Disney, Diese Woche im Trend und MP3s. Gültige clock50-Widgetpfade wieder verwenden. Eigene Ladekreisel mit begrenzter Laufzeit und erhaltenem Fokus. Vorhandene TVMaze-/TMDB-Bildsuche, Bilddownloads und manuelle Zuordnungen unverändert erhalten. Einstellungen, Provider, Token, EPG, Favoriten und persönliche Widgets bleiben erhalten. Android-Abnahme offen; noch keine Repository-Veröffentlichung.</news>
    <assets>
      <icon>icon-81da1003a2753ec6.png</icon>
      <fanart>resources/media/lightweight_splash.jpg</fanart>
    </assets>
  </extension>

</addon>

0.1.29.95 (2026-11-15) – EPG-Sicherungsfreigabe, Testkandidat
- Historische Sicherungsmeldung und tatsächliche Importfreigabe unabhängig prüfen. Gesperrte Datenbanken, Zeitbudgets, fehlende Belege und Speicherfehler eindeutig unterscheiden.
- Sicherungsprüfung im Hintergrund: mehr als 128 Archive und langsame Datenträger unterstützt; keine automatische neue Sicherung und keine Löschung vorhandener Daten.
- Profilsperren entlasten: untätiger Erinnerungstimer schreibt nicht mehr sekündlich; unveränderte, zuvor verifizierte Portaldateien bei vorübergehender Sperre weiter lesbar.
- EPG-Bestand quellweise und begrenzt prüfen. Bestätigte frühere Importzahlen bleiben bei vorübergehend beschäftigter Inventur als historische Nachweise sichtbar.
- Alle .94-Korrekturen übernommen. Android-Abnahme offen; kein Merge und keine Repository-Veröffentlichung.

0.1.29.94 (2026-11-14) – EPG-Stabilisierung, Testkandidat
- Neue Xtream-Einrichtung verwendet das tatsächliche Anbieter-EPG, wenn keine Quelle bewusst abgewählt wurde. Zugangsdaten und Passwörter bleiben erhalten.
- EPGShare01 DE/AT/CH und Kaimandura nachrüstbar; ausgeschaltetes EPG wird nur mit bestätigter Absicht aktiviert.
- Dauerhafter Importauftrag mit Dienstbestätigung, echten Byte-/Parser-/Mappingzählern und sicherem Abbruch. Quellenliste und Fernbedienungsfokus bleiben beim Statuspoll erhalten.
- Datenbank-Commit über unabhängiges SQLite-Readback prüfen. Gestreamte XMLTV-Rohdaten werden nicht als Dateien archiviert; unbekannte Dateien und LastGood bleiben geschützt.
- Mini-EPG lädt fehlende Sendergruppen auch bei vollständigem Hauptindex nach; Live-TV bleibt vom EPG-Import unabhängig.
- .93-Player-, Bild- und Widget-Korrekturen vollständig übernommen. Android/RK3528-Prüfung offen; keine automatische Veröffentlichung.

0.1.29.93 (2026-11-13)
- Fehlende native Stop-Quittung: einmalige echte FIFO-Fortschrittsprobe, kein zweiter Stop und kein vorgetäuschter ACK. Native Decoderblockade weiterhin Gerätegate.
- Gespeicherten Startsender bei temporär unvollständigem Katalog erhalten; Mini-EPG-Gruppen gezielt aus lokalem Index nachladen.
- Eigenes lesbares Speicherfenster statt Plot/JSON; fortsetzbare Inventuren mit expliziten Messlücken.
- Alte EPG-Sicherungen nur mit geprüfter aktueller Recovery-Kopie journalisiert begrenzen; unbekannte Rohdateien bleiben geschützt.
- EPG-Details von der BINGIE-Hero-Mindestgröße trennen; exaktes XMLTV-Bild bei ausstehender manueller Bildquelle behalten.
- Kein Merge oder Release, Android-Abnahme ausstehend.

0.1.29.92 – Speicher-/EPG-Stabilisierung, unveröffentlichter Testkandidat
- Verifizierte Senderlogos nach Kodi-Neustart unmittelbar im Widget verwenden; widerrufene Quellen bleiben gesperrt.
- Eigene Speicherübersicht, sichere begrenzte Wartung mit Journal und gemessenem Platzdelta.
- Parallele Erststarts ohne lange Imports oder GUI-Veröffentlichung unter der kurzen Profilsperre; bestehende Profile bleiben unverändert.
- Inkrementelle SQLite-Freigabe vollständig bis 128 Seiten ausführen und danach sicher per WAL-Checkpoint bestätigen; aktive Leser bleiben geschützt.
- Kleine Bildzuordnungen und Migrationsjournale unter eigener begrenzter Metadatenreserve speichern.
- USB-Migration mit Kopie, SHA256, Bildprüfung, Kodi-Neustart und separater Originalbereinigung.
- Veraltete EPG-Quellfakten begrenzt entfernen; aktive Zuordnungen, Reminder und Backups schützen.
- Now/Next-Snapshot nach bestätigtem zentralem EPG-Commit begrenzen; vollständigen Guide behalten.
- Bild-EPG ausdrücklich wählbar; vorhandene Freigaben und Profile bei Updates erhalten.
- Sichere Fokus-Ziele auch vor der Vorbereitung zusätzlicher Home-Reihen.
- Film-Neuheiten nach Providergruppen filtern, ohne den vollständigen Filmkatalog zu verändern.
- Android-Abnahme und weitere im Testbericht ausgewiesene Arbeiten offen. Kein Merge/Release.

0.1.29.21 (isolated series autoplay test candidate; baseline main .20)
- Session-local episode autoplay after verified natural Ended callbacks; numeric same-portal/same-series successors, number gaps and season transitions; no wrap, specials, ambiguous or foreign episodes.
- Stop/exit/error/shutdown and transition cancellation take priority; one new nonce per next episode, bounded callback queue, no GUI/HTTP/SQLite work in player callbacks, no restart from playback gaps.
- Selectively port the Kodi 21.2 own media OSD from #84, with episode-only Autoplay On/Off, native IR focus, protected audio/subtitle/seek/pause and Stop/Back handling.
- Natural-end checkpoint precedes handoff; current episode/season and return focus follow automatic starts. Manual Next, existing watched/resume storage and artwork retained.
- No persistent option migration, keymap change, EPG/Live-TV navigation change, data reset, merge or release. Android NOT_TESTED.

0.1.29.20 (isolated artwork test candidate on .19)
- Automatic artwork storage by available device capacity; configurable free reserve (1024 MiB default, at least 32). Explicit existing image limits retained; 0 means automatic, no 4096 MiB ceiling.
- Separate provider-source, queue, network, invalid-image, cache, configured-budget and physical-storage diagnostics; no private URLs in status/logs.
- Bounded, durable reactivation of exhausted SPACE_FULL jobs once per unchanged policy; READY/images and network retry limits preserved.
- SQLite enrolment moved off GUI callbacks into a bounded inbox/worker; visible EPG logos prioritized, fair queue turns, safe claim/lease completion and pause setting.
- Existing persistent local images refresh in visible rails/categories/EPG; focused poster status shown without list/focus reset.
- Display provider GS Media without fork suffix; complete existing licence/origin documents accessible under Info and attribution retained in addon information.
- No autoplay, player/Live/EPG-playback change, database reset, image cleanup, keymap change, merge/release or production index update. Android NOT_TESTED.

0.1.29.19 (isolated media UI/manual-next test candidate; baseline .18)
- Reduce category and rail posters to 108x162 (2:3); preserve font13 and wide two-line labels. Compact rail spacing; original 4/6-column grid and bounded paging retained.
- Place the existing native neon focus texture directly around each poster with a dark contrast edge; frame is visible only for the actively focused control.
- Manual Next in series details and a dedicated episode-list header button, relative to selected/last-played episode, numeric season/episode order, gaps and season boundaries; independent of watched status.
- Reject explicit foreign identities, ambiguous episode IDs/positions and invalid Next metadata; revalidate before an explicit click starts playback. Restore target season/episode and focus after return.
- No automatic next episode, OSD integration, player/service/Live/EPG change, data reset, production index update or release. Android NOT_TESTED.

0.1.29.18 (media/UI test candidate; main remains .17)
- Progressive 24-title category batches for movies and series, appended automatically near the native Down boundary; bounded 240-item moving UI window and category totals.
- 164x246 posters, two-line titles, top categories/search, Continue -> Favourites -> New, stable detail return and async artwork focus.
- Green eye = unseen, red eye = watched; permanent episode legend and existing progress preserved.
- Explicit portal-local Continue suppression for movies without deleting progress/favourites/seen state; a validated new movie request can reveal it again.
- Cancel stale metadata UI callbacks before playback; owner restores detail/episode focus after natural playback end even without a repeated onInit.
- No series auto-next, catch-up action, global keymap, artwork repair or automatic release. Android NOT_TESTED.

0.1.29.17 (isolated Live-TV Stop/Exit test candidate)
- Start channel is a Home action; legacy folder calls anchor Home before direct playback.
- Stop/long Back/Back from hidden TV requests a session-scoped exit. Service stops only the verified tagged item, waits for termination, closes its overlay and returns to XCMate Home.
- Cancel preplay/recovery/root-autoplay after explicit Exit until a new selection. No foreign player stops; no global keymap or data changes.
- Existing .16 EPG handoff and fixed 14:00 navigation preserved; Android acceptance pending.

0.1.29.16 (isolated EPG test candidate; no production publication)
- Defer Watch to a single existing live resolver after native callbacks, owner pump and navigation lock have ended; do not close/play inside the OK callback.
- Selected-channel diagnostics read the real long-term SQLite horizon, alias and sources separately from the local short cache, without import or data reset.
- Reproduced overlap navigation trap fixed separately: Right always advances and Left always goes back, including gaps and window transitions.
- Android acceptance remains required for the native Kodi crash; source/host checks cannot certify the RK3528 player lifecycle.

0.1.29.13 (separate horizontal guide test candidate)
- Fixed channel column, proportional shared time grid, native green focus, now line, local cache-only background pages and explicit programme actions.
- Legacy guide/live overlays remain available unchanged.

0.1.29.11 (test candidate)
- Read-only partial artwork status, bounded BUSY retry, reduced writer contention and private-safe SQLite diagnostics.
- Complete the legacy settings directory before opening the native settings dialog.

0.1.29.8 – Testkandidat: sichere Medienfokus-/Back-Navigation und Kodi-Aktionsrouting.
0.1.29.7 – Artwork-Jobdatenbank und Startsender-Route (Testkandidat)
- Atomic schema initialization; private SQLite diagnostics and bounded retries instead of MIGRATION_FAILED loops.
- Consistent WAL-aware backup and verified art_pending-only index repair; no automatic table/queue reset.
- Explicit confirmed queue recovery preserves image files, accounts, favourites, guide and progress.
- Successful home_start directory completion preserves direct live playback and remote navigation.
- Primary device: Kodi 21.2 / Android 13 / RK3528 ARM32; Kodi 21.3 remains supported.
- No production update or merge without release approval; 0.1.29.6 remains rollback.

0.1.29.6 – P0 Fensterstart nach Android-Regression #67 (Testkandidat)
- EPG-/Film-/Serienfenster starten wieder nach erfolgreichem Kodi-Verzeichnisabschluss.
- Vor Aktivierung auf Ende eines modalen Kodi-Ladedialogs warten; keine Zwangsschließung.
- Owner-Pump ohne Worker-GUI-Zugriffe bleibt; natives onInit wird überwacht und sicher diagnostiziert.
- Fensterfehler werden ohne Zugangsdaten protokolliert; Close-Fehler verdecken keinen Startfehler.
- EPG-Deduplikation, HEVC-Matching und Back-Hierarchie aus 0.1.29.5 erhalten.
- Keine Datenmigration/Resets und keine Änderung der Live-TV-/Fernbedienungsnavigation.
- Automatisierte Prüfung und Android-Geräteabnahme getrennt; kein automatisches Release/Merge.

0.1.29.5 – EPG-Dubletten und Navigation (Android-Fensterregression bekannt)
- Zentrale toleranzbasierte Dublettenbereinigung; legitime Episoden bleiben getrennt.
- Daten-Worker liefern Ergebnisse an den Fensterthread; konservative Sendernamensnormalisierung.
- EPG-/Medien-Back-Hierarchie und expliziter Rückweg zur Hauptübersicht.
- Android-Test negativ für Fensterstart; Korrekturkandidat 0.1.29.6 siehe oben.

0.1.29.4 – P0 Setup, Scan und verifiziertes Speichern (Testkandidat)
- WindowXML-Updates und Schließen nur auf dem Fenster-eigenen Python-Thread; Worker liefern Daten.
- Drei getrennte Kategorienlisten, echte PNG-Checkboxen, sichtbarer Fokus/Reiter und Auswahlzähler.
- Umschalten ohne Listenreset, getrennte Auswahl und Scrollposition pro Bereich.
- Lange Scans ohne Gesamtdeadline; Read-/Inaktivitätsschutz, Abbruch und Zykluserkennung bleiben.
- Frisches Staging, Save-Lock, permanente Readback-/Integritätsprüfung und Rollback nur neuer ID.
- Keine sofortige doppelte Kataloganforderung nach erfolgreichem Import.
- Keine Änderung am Live-/Remote-/Startsender-Freeze; Android-/IR-Abnahme offen, kein Release/Merge.

0.1.29.2 – Universeller Setup-Assistent und private Playlist-Bearbeitung (Testkandidat)
- Integrations-QA: späte Starts nach Zurück abbrechen; unvollständige M3U-Updates behalten Altbestand.
- Kodi-21.3-API geprüft, echte JPEG-Fanart im Paket korrekt referenziert; Service-Build 29.
- Kategorien vor selektivem Scan, private Zwischenablage und explizites Speichern.
- Gemeinsame Quellenadapter/Medienansichten für Xtream, M3U und Stalker.
- Persistenter M3U-Editor mit Overrides, Gruppenzuordnung, Reihenfolge und Export.
- EPG aus dauerhafter SQLite für sichtbare Sender nachladen; Quellen bleiben opt-in.
- Nicht-Xtream-Live-Navigation mit geprüften Item-Tags und asynchroner Linkauflösung.
- Keine automatische M3U-Konvertierung, kein Main-Merge/Release; Android-Abnahme offen.

0.1.29.1 – Aktive Gruppen und kontinuierliche Senderliste (Testkandidat)
- Live-Gruppen ohne AN/AUS; Menü öffnet Checkbox-Verwaltung ohne Providerzugriff.
- Durchgehendes Scrollen über interne 100er-Fenster, keine sichtbaren Seiteneinträge.
- Bewährte OK-/Back-/Zap- und Player-Methoden unverändert abgesichert.

0.1.29 – Dauerhafte Medienbilder und persönliche Reihen (Testkandidat)
- Bilddateien dauerhaft behalten; persistente Aufträge, begrenzte Wiederholung und konfigurierbares Speicherbudget.
- Neu hinzugefügt, Meine Favoriten und Weiter ansehen direkt in Film-/Serienstartseiten.
- Lokale Favoritenmetadaten auch offline, sofortiges Entfernen, Folgenstatus mit Prozent und nächste ungesehene Folge.

0.1.28.2 – Wiedergabe verlassen (Testkandidat)
- XCMate-eigene Film-/Seriensitzung bei Vollbild-Rückkehr stoppen und letzte Position sichern.
- Live-Overlay-Back bleibt unverändert; erst Wechsel zur Kodi-Navigation beendet eigene Live-Sitzung.
- Fremde Streams und bestehende Profile bleiben unberührt.

0.1.28.1 – Startstabilität (Testkandidat, noch nicht freigegeben)
- Hauptmenü und Widgets ohne HTTP-Import oder automatische Portal-Migration starten.
- Datensparsame BOOT-Phasenmarker und kontrollierter Verzeichnisabschluss bei Startfehlern.
- Portaldateien streng und ohne Reset lesen; Legacy-Übernahme ausdrücklich auslösen.
- Widget-Abfragen begrenzen und doppelte EPG-Worker abbrechen; Live-TV-Navigation unverändert.

0.1.28 — review candidate (not published)
- Stream active Xtream categories into atomic, batch-written SQLite generations.
- Immediate local media windows, progressive search and explicit import errors.
- Stream large XMLTV into the ten-day guide; shared start-group Now/Next.
- Separate pre-play status/handshake; frozen live remote callbacks retained.
- Independent bundled DE/EN language; core appearance preview and persistence.
- Premium theme and external language installers remain separate work.

msgid "Allow local staging and verified transfer for this destination? Requires space for the complete file. Interruptions preserve partials; retry copies the verified local file again. No automatic fallback to an internal destination. The non-atomic USB copy method may leave a visible incomplete destination file; XCMate never enables its playback. Local stages are retained for recovery."
msgstr "Für dieses Ziel lokale Zwischenablage und geprüfte Zielübertragung erlauben? Benötigt Platz für die ganze Datei. Unterbrechungen erhalten den Dateianteil; erneut versuchen kopiert die geprüfte lokale Datei neu. Keine automatische Rückkehr zum internen Ziel. Bei nicht-atomarem USB-Verfahren kann eine unvollständige Zieldatei sichtbar bleiben; XCMate gibt sie nicht zur Wiedergabe frei. Lokale Zwischenkopien bleiben zur Wiederherstellung erhalten."

msgctxt "#36428"
msgid "This Home profile cannot safely be edited directly (not yet saved, renamed Home or single-widget mode). Open the native BINGIE editor? Choose the desired Home widget position there. After the separately approved Home patch, the direct XCMate candidates appear in its widget selector. No reset is needed."
msgstr "Dieses Home-Profil lässt sich nicht sicher direkt bearbeiten (noch nicht gespeichert, Home umbenannt oder Einzelwidget-Modus). Den nativen BINGIE-Editor öffnen? Dort die gewünschte Home-Position wählen. Nach dem separat freigegebenen Home-Patch stehen die direkten XCMate-Kandidaten in seiner Widgetauswahl bereit. Kein Reset erforderlich."

msgid "Open native BINGIE setup"
msgstr "Native BINGIE-Einrichtung öffnen"

msgid "Use the configured credentials? Values from XCMate → Configure will be used for a new setup without displaying them here. Existing portals are preserved. Missing values can be completed."

msgctxt "#36501"
msgid "A previous setup job is still closing. Please wait briefly and reopen the wizard."
msgstr "Ein vorheriger Einrichtungsauftrag wird noch beendet. Bitte kurz warten und den Assistenten erneut öffnen."

msgctxt "#36502"
msgid "Setup timed out. Cancellation has been requested. Existing portals are preserved. Check your connection and reopen; a running job will not be started twice."
msgstr "Zeitüberschreitung bei der Einrichtung. Der Auftrag wurde zum Abbruch aufgefordert. Bereits gespeicherte Portale bleiben erhalten. Bitte Verbindung prüfen und erneut öffnen; ein noch laufender Auftrag wird nicht doppelt gestartet."

msgctxt "#36503"

msgstr "Gruppen anzeigen: {0} / {1}"

msgstr "Auswahlmarkierungen werden aktualisiert …"

msgstr "Einrichtung speichern: Daten werden in geprüften Blöcken übertragen …"

msgctxt "#36506"

msgstr "Einrichtung speichern: gespeicherte Daten und Index prüfen …"

msgctxt "#36510"
msgid "XCMate {0} is installed.\n\n• EPG manager: source comparison and live preview in the guide.\n• Automatic EPG updates every 24 hours by default, with readable reports.\n• Wizard: keep inputs and selected groups when errors occur.\n• Password remains available during Back and Retry in the current setup.\n\nAfter restarting Kodi, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and widgets are preserved."
msgstr "XCMate {0} ist installiert.\n\n• EPG-Manager: Quellenvergleich und Live-Vorschau im Raster.\n• EPG automatisch alle 24 Stunden als Standard, mit lesbaren Berichten.\n• Wizard: Eingaben und gewählte Gruppen bleiben bei Fehlern erhalten.\n• Das Passwort bleibt bei Zurück und Wiederholen in der laufenden Einrichtung erhalten.\n\nNach einem Kodi-Neustart muss ein nicht gespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Widgets bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36520"
msgid "Installation successful"
msgstr "Installation erfolgreich"

msgctxt "#36521"
msgid "Version {0}\n\nChanges:\n• Connection checked separately, with a clear success message.\n• Completed catalogue groups survive retries.\n• Portal saved before optional EPG imports.\n• EPG sources resume separately, with real progress and no total runtime limit.\n• New passwords remain editable during the running setup.\n• Clearer group counts and the regular XCMate background.\n\nAfter a new Kodi/Python session, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and settings are preserved."
msgstr "Version {0}\n\nÄnderungen:\n• Verbindung getrennt prüfen und Erfolg klar bestätigen.\n• Abgeschlossene Kataloggruppen bei Wiederholung erhalten.\n• Portal vor dem optionalen EPG-Import speichern.\n• EPG-Quellen einzeln fortsetzen, mit echtem Fortschritt und ohne Gesamtlaufzeitgrenze.\n• Neue Passwörter bleiben in der laufenden Einrichtung bearbeitbar.\n• Lesbare Gruppenzahlen und regulärer XCMate-Hintergrund.\n\nNach einer neuen Kodi-/Python-Sitzung muss ein ungespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Einstellungen bleiben erhalten."

msgid "Create an XCMate-owned target folder and a temporary 4 KiB file, read back and verify its SHA256, then remove only that test file? This does not grant Android permissions, activate the target or delete original pictures."

msgctxt "#38303"
msgid "All sizes are bytes. available is usable by Kodi; free also includes reserved blocks. Equal volume keys mean the same allocation pool. No capacity gain is promised. Programme images, Kodi textures, metadata and databases remain in their existing locations."
msgstr "Alle Größen in Bytes. available ist für Kodi nutzbar; free enthält auch reservierte Blöcke. Gleiche Volume-Kennung bedeutet denselben Speicherpool. Kein Speichergewinn zugesagt. Sendungsbilder, Kodi-Texturen, Metadaten und Datenbanken bleiben an ihren bisherigen Orten."

msgctxt "#38310"

msgctxt "#38311"
msgid "The target is read-only or the write failed. Check Kodi access rights and the selected volume. Originals remain unchanged."

msgctxt "#38312"
msgid "Android denies access, or no reachable shared folder is available. Kodi folder selection does not grant SAF access. This Kodi/Python interface has no verified SAF bridge. Choose a folder already accessible to Kodi; XCMate will not bypass Android permissions."
msgstr "Android verweigert den Zugriff oder kein erreichbarer gemeinsamer Ordner ist verfügbar. Die Kodi-Ordnerwahl erteilt keine SAF-Freigabe. Für diese Kodi/Python-Schnittstelle ist keine SAF-Brücke verifiziert. Einen für Kodi bereits zugänglichen Ordner wählen; XCMate umgeht keine Android-Rechte."

msgctxt "#38314"
msgid "Insufficient usable target space after the effective safety reserve. No reserve was disabled and no files were deleted."
msgstr "Nach Abzug der wirksamen Sicherheitsreserve fehlt nutzbarer Zielspeicher. Keine Reserve wurde abgeschaltet und keine Datei gelöscht."

msgctxt "#38315"

msgid "The artwork journal or worker is busy. Limited retries ended; retry the same operation later. Existing transfer records and originals are retained."

msgctxt "#38318"

msgstr "Rücklese- oder SHA256-Prüfung fehlgeschlagen. Das Ziel bleibt inaktiv und Originalbilder bleiben erhalten. Erst nach Prüfung des Ziels fortsetzen."

msgstr "Bildaktion sicher abgebrochen. Originale und gewählter Speichermodus wurden nicht absichtlich zurückgesetzt. Diagnosecode prüfen und bestehende Aktion erneut versuchen."

"""Source-qualified manual bindings without changing legacy channel strings.

Only explicit Save writes configuration. Preview reads the retained per-source
archive, never changes source priorities/aliases or writes guide SQLite.
"""
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time
from urllib.parse import quote


class Mappings(dict):
    def __init__(self,legacy=(),sources=None):
        super().__init__(legacy);self.sources48=dict(sources or {})


def sources(portal):
    from epg_sources import configuration
    from guide_publish44 import source_id
    result=[dict(id='provider',name='Anbieter-EPG / Xtream')]
    for rank,source in enumerate(configuration(portal['id'])['sources'],1):
        if source.get('enabled',True):result.append(dict(id=source_id(source,rank),name=str(source.get('name') or 'XMLTV')[:160]))
    return result


def connection():
    from guide_store import path
    filename=path()
    if not os.path.isfile(filename):return None
    db=sqlite3.connect('file:'+quote(filename,safe='/')+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=.03)
    db.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON');db.execute('BEGIN')
    deadline=time.monotonic()+.15
    db.set_progress_handler(lambda:int(time.monotonic()>deadline),1000)
    return db


def channels(pid,source,query='',offset=0):
    named=named_channels(pid,source,query,offset)
    if named:return named
    db=connection()
    if db is None:return []
    try:
        # No wildcard escaping ambiguity; instr treats user text literally.
        values=db.execute('''SELECT DISTINCT cid FROM guide44_inputs
          WHERE pid=? AND source_id=? AND instr(lower(cid),lower(?))>0
          ORDER BY cid LIMIT 100 OFFSET ?''',(str(pid),source,str(query)[:160],max(0,int(offset)))).fetchall()
        return [dict(id=r[0],name=r[0],first=None,last=None) for r in values]
    except sqlite3.Error:return []
    finally:db.close()


def read(db,pid,cid,source,start,stop,limit=48):
    """Read exact source even when two XMLTV feeds use identical channel IDs."""
    try:
        rows=db.execute('''SELECT title,description,start,stop,rank FROM guide44_inputs
          WHERE pid=? AND source_id=? AND cid=? AND start<? AND stop>?
          ORDER BY start,stop LIMIT ?''',(str(pid),source,cid,stop,start,min(256,limit))).fetchall()
        if not rows:
            from programme_index46 import window
            return window(pid,cid,start,stop,limit=limit,source48=source)
        return [dict(name=r[0],descr=r[1],start_timestamp=r[2],stop_timestamp=r[3],source=r[4],_source_index=r[4],source_key46=source) for r in rows]
    except sqlite3.Error:return []


def preview(mappings,sid,cid,source):
    value=Mappings(mappings,getattr(mappings,'sources48',{}))
    value[str(sid)]=str(cid);value.sources48[str(sid)]=dict(channel=str(cid),source=str(source))
    return value


def save(portal,sid,cid,source):
    if source not in {r['id'] for r in sources(portal)}:raise ValueError('SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED')
    if not str(cid) or len(str(cid))>512:raise ValueError('CHANNEL_REQUIRED')
    from profile_transaction import writing
    from epg_sources import configuration,_save
    with writing(timeout=.2):
        state=configuration(portal['id'])
        state['mappings'][str(sid)]=str(cid)
        state.setdefault('source_mappings48',{})[str(sid)]=dict(channel=str(cid),source=source)
        _save(portal['id'],state)
    return True


def binding(mappings,sid):
    value=getattr(mappings,'sources48',{}).get(str(sid))
    if (isinstance(value,dict) and value.get('channel')==mappings.get(str(sid))
            and isinstance(value.get('source'),str)):
        return value
    return None


def stage_channels(pid,generation,source,rows,guide=None):
    from programme_index46 import connect
    db=None
    try:
        db=connect(True,guide)
        with db:
            db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_channels48(pid TEXT,source_id TEXT,cid TEXT,name TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(pid,source_id,cid))')
            db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pending_channels48(generation TEXT,pid TEXT,source_id TEXT,cid TEXT,name TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(generation,pid,source_id,cid))')
            db.executemany('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO pending_channels48 VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',[(generation,str(pid),source,str(cid)[:512],str(name)[:512]) for cid,name in rows])
        return True
    except (OSError,sqlite3.Error,ValueError):return False
    finally:
        if db is not None:db.close()


def finish_channels(pid,generation,publish,guide=None):
    from programme_index46 import connect
    db=None
    try:
        db=connect(False,guide)
        if db is None or not db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='pending_channels48'").fetchone():return
        db.close();db=connect(True,guide)
        with db:
            if publish:
                db.execute('''INSERT OR REPLACE INTO source_channels48 SELECT pid,source_id,cid,name
                  FROM pending_channels48 WHERE pid=? AND generation=?''',(str(pid),generation))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM pending_channels48 WHERE pid=? AND generation=?',(str(pid),generation))
    except (OSError,sqlite3.Error,ValueError):pass
    finally:
        if db is not None:db.close()


def named_channels(pid,source,query='',offset=0):
    from programme_index46 import connect
    db=None
    try:
        db=connect(False)
        if db is None:return []
        deadline=time.monotonic()+.15;db.set_progress_handler(lambda:int(time.monotonic()>deadline),1000)
        return [dict(id=r[0],name=r[1],first=None,last=None) for r in db.execute('''SELECT cid,name FROM source_channels48
          WHERE pid=? AND source_id=? AND (instr(lower(cid),lower(?))>0 OR instr(lower(name),lower(?))>0)
          ORDER BY cid LIMIT 100 OFFSET ?''',(str(pid),source,str(query)[:160],str(query)[:160],max(0,int(offset))))]
    except (OSError,sqlite3.Error,ValueError):return []
    finally:
        if db is not None:db.close()


def qualified_cache(cache,mappings,sid):
    """Pure source proof for every Now/Next caller, including startup preload."""
    selected=binding(mappings,sid)
    if not selected:return cache
    cid=selected['channel'];source=selected['source']
    rows=cache.get(cid,[]) if isinstance(cache,dict) else []
    return {cid:[row for row in rows if isinstance(row,dict) and
        (row.get('source_key46') or row.get('epg_source46'))==source]}

"""EPG intent, independent global/provider switches and cold save verification.

Unknown legacy false is never guessed to be consent. Only an explicitly
recorded implicit disable can be repaired without a user confirmation.
"""
from localization import tr


def setup_default(draft):
    p=draft.data
    explicit_off=p.get('epg_show') is False or p.get('epg_opt_out94') is True
    p['epg_opt_out94']=explicit_off
    p.setdefault('provider_epg_opt_out94',p.get('provider_epg_enabled') is False)
    enabled=p.get('type')=='xtream' and not explicit_off and not p['provider_epg_opt_out94']
    if enabled:
        # Use the configured source adapter, never probe guessed host paths.
        try:enabled=bool(draft.adapter.get_xmltv_epg_url())
        except (AttributeError,OSError,ValueError,RuntimeError):enabled=False
    draft.provider_epg=enabled


def selected(draft):
    draft.data['epg_opt_out94']=not bool(draft.provider_epg or draft.epg_sources)
    draft.data['provider_epg_opt_out94']=not draft.provider_epg


def set_global(pid,enabled):
    from portals import update,get_by_id
    from profile_transaction import writing
    with writing():
        if not get_by_id(pid):raise ValueError('EPG_PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE')
        update(pid,dict(epg_show=bool(enabled),epg_opt_out94=not bool(enabled)))

"""Instant Now/Next guide data for the on-video channel list and Kodi widgets.

This module only reads existing normalized EPG cache: remote button presses and
skin-widget refreshes must never wait for an external Xtream server.

import time


def _as_int(value):
    try:
        return int(float(value))
    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
        return 0


def _find_events(data, ids):
    for ident in ids:
        if ident and isinstance(data.get(str(ident)), list):
            return data[str(ident)]
    return []


def guide_for_channel(cache, epg_id='', stream_id='', now=None):
    """Return now/next dict; empty strings mean the provider has no EPG data."""
    result = {'now': '', 'next': '', 'description': '', 'image': '',
              'now_time': '', 'now_end_time': '', 'next_time': '', 'next_end_time': '',
              'start': 0, 'stop': 0, 'next_start': 0, 'next_stop': 0,
              'progress': None, 'elapsed': None, 'remaining': None,
              'events': [], 'epg_id': '', 'source_index': None, 'reason': 'NO_DATA'}
    if not isinstance(cache, dict):
        return result
    ts = int(time.time() if now is None else now)
    # A manually mapped Xtream stream ID must override the provider's guide ID.
    ident = next((str(i) for i in (stream_id, epg_id)
                  if i and isinstance(cache.get(str(i)), list) and cache[str(i)]), '')
    events = cache.get(ident, [])
    result['epg_id'] = ident
    from epg_events import deduplicate
    clean=deduplicate(events,channel=ident)
    valid=[(e['start'],e['stop'],e['title'],e) for e in clean]
    result['events'] = [dict(e) for e in clean if e['stop']>ts][:48]
    current = next((item for item in valid if item[0] <= ts < item[1]), None)
    future = next((item for item in valid if item[0] > ts), None)
    if current:
        result['now'] = current[2]
        result['now_time'] = time.strftime('%H:%M', time.localtime(current[0]))
        result.update(start=current[0], stop=current[1], elapsed=ts-current[0],
                      remaining=current[1]-ts,
                      progress=max(0., min(1., (ts-current[0])/(current[1]-current[0]))),
                      now_end_time=time.strftime('%H:%M', time.localtime(current[1])),
                      source_index=current[3].get('_source_index'), reason='READY')
        result['description'] = str(current[3].get('descr') or current[3].get('description') or '')
        result['image'] = str(current[3].get('screenshot_uri') or '')
        # Following programme must begin after the current programme.
        future = next((item for item in valid if item[0] >= current[1]), None)
    if future:
        result['next'] = future[2]
        result['next_time'] = time.strftime('%H:%M', time.localtime(future[0]))
        result.update(next_start=future[0], next_stop=future[1],
                      next_end_time=time.strftime('%H:%M', time.localtime(future[1])))
        if not current: result['reason'] = 'FUTURE_ONLY'
        if not current: result['source_index'] = future[3].get('_source_index')
    return result


def resolve_guide(cache, epg_id='', stream_id='', now=None, client=None, mappings=None):
    """One local resolver for directory, TV snapshot and programme preview.

    Explicit mapping wins even if a stale stream alias remains in the cache.
    Cached short EPG is a fallback for missing *current* XMLTV data, never HTTP.
    """
    sid = str(stream_id or '')
    mapped = (mappings or {}).get(sid)
    if mapped:
        from epg_binding48 import qualified_cache
        result = guide_for_channel(qualified_cache(cache,mappings,sid), str(mapped), now=now)
        result['epg_id'] = str(mapped)
        result['mapping'] = 'MANUAL'
        if not result['events']: result['reason'] = 'MANUAL_ID_MISSING'
        return result
    result = guide_for_channel(cache, epg_id, sid, now)
    # A nonempty but expired/future SID alias must not mask a valid NOW
    # at this same channel's provider ID. Explicit mappings returned above.
    if not result['now'] and epg_id and str(epg_id)!=sid:
        provider67=guide_for_channel(cache,str(epg_id),now=now)
        if provider67['now']:result=provider67
    result['mapping'] = 'STREAM_ALIAS' if result['epg_id'] == sid and sid else 'PROVIDER_ID'
    if not result['now'] and client is not None and sid:
        short = cached_short_guide(client, sid, now)
        if short['now'] or (not result['next'] and short['next']):
            if short['now'] and not short['next'] and result['next_start']>=short['stop']:
                for key in ('next','next_time','next_end_time','next_start','next_stop'):
                    short[key]=result[key]
                short['events']+= [e for e in result['events'] if e['start']>=short['stop']]
                short['events']=short['events'][:48]
            short.update(epg_id=sid, mapping='SHORT_EPG', source_index=-1)
            return short
    return result

def _short_guide(raw, now=None):
    """Normalize cached get_short_epg events into XMLTV-compatible Now/Next."""
    import base64
    ts = int(time.time() if now is None else now)
    entries = raw.get('epg_listings', []) if isinstance(raw, dict) else []
    normalized = []
    for item in entries:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        title = str(item.get('title') or '').strip()
        try:
            decoded = base64.b64decode(title, validate=True).decode('utf-8')
            if decoded.strip():
                title = decoded
        except (ValueError, TypeError, UnicodeError):
            pass
        start = _as_int(item.get('start_timestamp'))
        stop = _as_int(item.get('stop_timestamp') or item.get('end_timestamp'))
        if not stop:
            # Only an explicitly named seconds field is unambiguous. Generic
            # "duration" differs between providers; never invent its unit.
            duration = _as_int(item.get('duration_secs'))
            if 0 < duration <= 86400: stop = start + duration
        if start > 0 and stop > start and title:
            record=dict(item,name=title,start_timestamp=start,stop_timestamp=stop,_source_index=-1)
            description=str(item.get('description') or item.get('descr') or '')
            try: description=base64.b64decode(description,validate=True).decode('utf-8')
            except (ValueError,TypeError,UnicodeError): pass
            record['descr']=description
            normalized.append(record)
    from epg_events import deduplicate
    decisions=[];clean=deduplicate(normalized,channel='_short',decisions=decisions)
    result=guide_for_channel({'_short':clean},'_short',now=ts)
    result.update(raw_count=len(entries),unique_count=len(clean),duplicates=len(normalized)-len(clean),
                  dedup_decisions=decisions)
    return result

def cached_short_guide(client, stream_id, now=None):
    if not stream_id:
        return guide_for_channel({}, now=now)
    # Old four-event caches remain valid. Extended results use a separate key;
    # only the service may fill it, never remote navigation or local views.
    best=None
    for limit in (12,4):
        try:
            data=client._get_json('get_short_epg',
                extra={'stream_id':str(stream_id),'limit':limit},cached_only=True)
        except (OSError,TimeoutError,ValueError):
            # A failed extended cache must not hide a valid four-event cache.
            # Cache-only read: no new network retry or cache/config mutation.
            continue
        guide=_short_guide(data,now=now)
        if best is None or (bool(guide['now']),len(guide['events']))>(bool(best['now']),len(best['events'])):
            best=guide
    return best if best is not None else guide_for_channel({},now=now)

def _view_key(path):
    import hashlib,json,urllib.parse
    p=urllib.parse.urlsplit(path)
    q=dict(urllib.parse.parse_qsl(p.query))

        return ''
    data=[q.get('pid',''),q.get('group',''),q.get('page','0')]
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(data,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()

def poll_short_guides():
    import json,xbmcgui
    import portals
    global _LAST_REQUEST
    window=xbmcgui.Window(10000)
    raw=window.getProperty('XtreamMate.ShortGuideRequest')

def _start_short_guides(portal, sids, view_key=''):
    """Prefetch missing visible TV programmes without waiting in Kodi navigation."""
    import threading
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
    from xtream import XtreamClient
    global _SHORT_LOCK
    if _SHORT_LOCK is None:
        _SHORT_LOCK = threading.Lock()
    if not isinstance(portal, dict) or portal.get('type') not in ('xtream','stb'):
        return
    pid = str(portal['id'])
    current = time.time()
    with _SHORT_LOCK:
        if _SHORT_INFLIGHT:
            return False
        ids = [sid for sid in sids if current-_SHORT_SEEN.get((pid,sid),0)>1800
               and current-_SHORT_FAILED.get((pid,sid),0)>30]
        if not ids:
            return True
        _SHORT_INFLIGHT.add(pid)
    def worker():
        try:
            changed=[]
            if portal.get('type')=='stb':
                from source_adapters import for_portal
                xc=for_portal(portal)
            else: xc = XtreamClient(portal['xc_host'],portal['xc_user'],portal['xc_pass'])
            def fetch(sid):
                cached=cached_short_guide(xc,sid)
                if (cached['now'] or cached['next']) and not (cached.get('duplicates') and cached.get('unique_count',0)<4):
                    _SHORT_SEEN[(pid,sid)]=time.time()
                    return
                try:
                    data=xc.get_short_epg(sid,limit=12,force_refresh=True)
                    guide=_short_guide(data)
                    # Optional diagnostics must never turn valid EPG into a
                    # failed fetch (e.g. inaccessible profile during shutdown).
                    try:
                        from epg_dedup_diagnostics import record
                        record(pid,sid,guide)
                    except Exception: pass
                    if guide['now'] or guide['next']:
                        _SHORT_SEEN[(pid,sid)]=time.time()
                        changed.append(sid)
                    else:
                        _SHORT_FAILED[(pid,sid)]=time.time()
                except Exception:
                    _SHORT_FAILED[(pid,sid)]=time.time()
            # Start/first visible channel is completed before lower priorities.
            if ids: fetch(ids[0])
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
                list(executor.map(fetch,ids[1:]))
            for history in (_SHORT_SEEN,_SHORT_FAILED):
                if len(history)>512:
                    for key in sorted(history,key=history.get)[:-512]:
                        history.pop(key,None)
            if changed:
                import xbmcgui,uuid
                xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty('XCMate.ShortGuideRevision.'+pid,uuid.uuid4().hex)
            if view_key and changed:
                # Never refresh an unrelated directory or steal fullscreen
                # focus when the user has left the requested sender page.
                refresh_visible_page(pid,view_key)
        finally:
            with _SHORT_LOCK:
                _SHORT_INFLIGHT.discard(pid)
    try:
        threading.Thread(target=worker,daemon=True,name='XCMateShortGuide').start()
    except RuntimeError:
        with _SHORT_LOCK: _SHORT_INFLIGHT.discard(pid)
        return False
    return True

"""Generation-pinned Live metadata, no UNION/GROUP BY of full payloads."""
import json,os,sqlite3,time
from urllib.parse import quote


def read(portal,publish=lambda value:None,categories=None,only=None,receipt94=None):
    from widget_data41 import WidgetReader
    from library_index import path,initial_group,IndexReadError
    reader=WidgetReader(portal['id']);state=reader.state('live')
    if state is None:return None
    groups=reader.groups('live')
    from group_selection import load,enabled_ids
    selected=load(portal['id'],'live')
    if selected and not selected.issubset({g['cid'] for g in groups}):return None
    if categories is not None and not enabled_ids(portal['id'],'live',categories).issubset({g['cid'] for g in groups}):return None
    categories=categories if categories is not None else [dict(category_id=g['cid'],category_name=g['title']) for g in groups]
    start=reader.get('live',str(portal.get('start_stream_id') or ''));cid=initial_group(portal,groups,start)
    ordered=sorted(groups,key=lambda g:g['cid']!=cid)
    if only is not None:
        ordered=[g for g in groups if g['cid']==str(only)]
        if not ordered:raise IndexReadError('GROUP_NOT_AVAILABLE')
    db=sqlite3.connect('file:'+quote(reader.filename or path(),safe='/')+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=.05);db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    streams=[];seen=set();head=None
    try:
        db.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON');db.execute('BEGIN')
        for group in ordered:
            head=db.execute('SELECT generation FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(reader.pid,'live',group['cid'])).fetchone()
            table='items_v2' if head else 'titles';args=[reader.pid,'live',group['cid']]
            where='pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?'
            if head:where+=' AND generation=?';args.append(head[0])
            last=None
            while True:
                deadline=time.monotonic()+.25;db.set_progress_handler(lambda:int(time.monotonic()>deadline),1000)
                suffix=' AND (ordinal>? OR (ordinal=? AND sid>?))' if last else ''
                rows=db.execute('SELECT ordinal,sid,payload FROM '+table+' WHERE '+where+suffix+' ORDER BY ordinal,sid LIMIT 128',args+(list(last) if last else [])).fetchall()
                if not rows:break
                for row in rows:
                    if row['sid'] in seen:continue
                    seen.add(row['sid']);item=json.loads(row['payload']);streams.append(dict(item,stream_id=item['sid']))
                    if len(streams)>50000:return categories,None
                last=(rows[-1]['ordinal'],rows[-1]['ordinal'],rows[-1]['sid'])
            if only is not None and not streams and not head:raise IndexReadError('GROUP_NOT_IMPORTED')
            if group['cid']==cid:publish((categories,list(streams)))
        after=reader.state('live')
        if not after or (after.get('revision'),after.get('updated'))!=(state.get('revision'),state.get('updated')):
            raise IndexReadError('REVISION_CHANGED')
        if receipt94 is not None:
            receipt94.update(revision=state.get('revision'),updated=state.get('updated'),generation=head[0] if only is not None and head else None,count=len(streams))
        return categories,streams
    except (sqlite3.Error,ValueError,TypeError) as exc:
        raise IndexReadError('LOCAL_LIVE_UNAVAILABLE') from None
    finally:db.close()

First OK: compact programme info. Second OK/Down: player controls.
Left opens indexed channels; Left again opens groups. Back returns one level.
Up/Down zap only in full-screen mode. Stop releases playback and dialog.

Kodi handles native list movement before Python callbacks. Bridge commands move
the list explicitly; native events must not move it a second time. No network
requests are made in input callbacks.

def session_from_property(raw, now=None):
    try:
        obj = json.loads(raw)
        if (not isinstance(obj, dict) or not obj.get('pid') or not obj.get('sid')
                or not obj.get('nonce')):
            if raw: trace('session','MARKER_INVALID',marker=True)
            return None
        at=float(obj.get('at',0))
        if not math.isfinite(at):
            trace('session','MARKER_INVALID',marker=True)
            return None
        if abs((time.time() if now is None else now) - at) > 86400:
            trace('session','MARKER_EXPIRED',marker=True)
            return None
        return obj
    except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
        if raw: trace('session','MARKER_INVALID',marker=True)
        return None


def category_rows(categories, enabled):
    """Normal navigation contains active groups only; management keeps all."""
    selected=None if enabled is None else set(map(str,enabled))
    rows=[(str(c['category_id']),str(c.get('category_name') or c['category_id']),True)
          for c in categories if c.get('category_id') not in (None,'') and (selected is None or str(c['category_id']) in selected)]
    return [('*','Alle aktivierten Gruppen',True)]+rows if rows else [
        ('','Keine aktiven Gruppen – Menü: Gruppen verwalten',False)]


def channels_for_category(channels, category_id, enabled):
    active = None if enabled is None else {str(x) for x in enabled}
    return [ch for ch in channels
            if (active is None or str(ch.extra.get('category_id', '')) in active)
            and (category_id == '*' or str(ch.extra.get('category_id', '')) == category_id)]


def adjacent_channel(channels, category_id, enabled, current_sid, step):
    """Next/previous channel in provider order; wrap at group boundaries.

    Categories are identified by provider IDs, never translated display names.
    Disabled categories are excluded. Unknown station: select first/last.
    """
    choices = channels_for_category(channels, category_id, enabled)
    if not choices:
        return None
    current = str(current_sid)
    idx = next((i for i, channel in enumerate(choices)
                if str(channel.extra.get('stream_id', '')) == current), None)
    if idx is None:
        return choices[0 if step > 0 else -1]
    return choices[(idx + (1 if step > 0 else -1)) % len(choices)]

    def owns_playback(self):
        """Release input immediately if playback belongs to another add-on."""
        try:
            player = xbmc.Player()
            if not player.isPlayingVideo():
                return False
            from live_recovery import playback_match
            session=session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
            match,reason = playback_match(player,[self.portal],lambda *args:self._identity_client,session)
            if not match and self._previous_session and time.monotonic()<self._tune_deadline:
                match,reason=playback_match(player,[self.portal],lambda *args:self._identity_client,self._previous_session)
                if match: reason='PREVIOUS_'+reason
            trace('ownership',reason,video=True,marker=bool(session),catalog=self._catalog_ready)
            if not match or match[0] != str(self.portal['id']):
                return False
            # Player.play is asynchronous; the old verified live URL may remain
            # visible briefly while Kodi resolves the newly selected channel.
            return (match[1] == self.sid or
                    (match[1] == self._recent_sid and
                     time.monotonic() < self._tune_deadline))
        except Exception:
            trace('ownership','CHECK_FAILED')
            return False

        if self._closed or getattr(self,'_exiting',False) or getattr(self,'_guide_handoff',False):
            return False
        if not self.owns_playback():
            self.close()
            return False
        from playback_exit import identity
        try:self._owned_token=identity(xbmc.Player())
        except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):self._owned_token=None
        mark(self,'OWNER_READY')
        return True

            if key != self._list_key:
                self.control.reset()
                self.control.addItems(labels)
                self._labels,self._list_key = labels,key
                pos = self._highlight[self.mode]
                if self.mode=='channels': pos = pos-self._page_start+self._row_offset
                self.control.selectItem(min(max(pos,0),len(labels)-1))
            self.heading.setLabel('XCMate - '+{'channels':'LIVE-TV','groups':'SENDERGRUPPEN','guide':'PROGRAMM'}[self.mode])
            if self.mode=='channels':
                self.sub.setLabel('{} Sender'.format(len(self.visible_channels)))
            elif self.mode=='guide':
                ch=self.index.by_sid.get(self._guide_sid)
                self.sub.setLabel(ch.name if ch else 'Programmübersicht')
            else: self.sub.setLabel('OK: öffnen    Menü: Gruppen verwalten')
            self._render_rows()
            target = self._mini.list if self.mode=='channels' and self._mini.focused else self.control
        render_end = time.perf_counter()
        if focus: self.setFocus(target)
        from ui_latency39 import mark,finish
        mark(self,'GUI_APPLIED');finish(self)
        trace('performance',self.mode.upper(),index_ms=index_ms,snapshot_ms=self._snapshot_ms,
              render_ms=max(0,(render_end-begin)*1000-index_ms-self._snapshot_ms),focus_ms=(time.perf_counter()-render_end)*1000,
              items=len(getattr(self,'_labels',[])) if listing else 0)

    def tick(self):
        if self._closed or not self._drawn: return
        if getattr(self,'_programme_request46',None):
            from programme_window46 import open_pending
            open_pending(self)
        from playback_exit import identity
        from osd_ownership import recover
        player=xbmc.Player();token=identity(player)
        if token and token[0]=='live' and token[1]['pid']==str(self.portal['id']) and token[1]['sid']==self.sid:
            if recover(player,token):
                self._standard_recovery=True
                self._recovery_target40=self.mode if self.mode in ('controls','extras') else 'info'
                return
            if getattr(self,'_standard_recovery',False):
                dialog=xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowDialogId()
                if dialog in (0,9999):
                    self._standard_recovery=False;self.mode=getattr(self,'_recovery_target40','info')
                    self._info_deadline=time.monotonic()+self._info_timeout if self.mode=='info' else None
                    self.show()
        now=time.monotonic()
        if self.mode=='info' and self._info_deadline is not None and now>=self._info_deadline:
            self._switch('hidden')
            return
        if self.mode=='channels':
            task93=getattr(self,'_group_task93',None)
            if task93 and task93[1].done():self._render(focus=False)
        if now-self._last_tick<1: return
        self._last_tick=now
        if self.mode=='info': self._render_info()
        elif self.mode in ('controls','extras'):
            self._render(focus=False)
        elif self.mode in ('channels','groups','guide') and self._guide.generation!=self._guide_generation:
            self._guide_generation=self._guide.generation
            self._render(focus=False)

    def expire_intro(self):
        """Service timer: refresh local info and expire only the INFO_BAR."""
        self.tick()

    def _position(self, step):
        if self.mode=='channels':
            self._move_channels(step)
            return
        count = self.control.size()
        if count > 0:
            i = min(max(self.control.getSelectedPosition() + step, 0), count - 1)
            self.control.selectItem(i)
            self._remember_position()
            self._render_rows()

    def _remember_position(self):
        i = self.control.getSelectedPosition()
        if self.mode == 'channels':
            i = self._page_start + i - self._row_offset
            # Page links are not channels and must never become tune targets.
            if not self._page_start <= i < min(self._page_start+CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE,
                                                len(self.visible_channels)):
                return
        self._highlight[self.mode] = i

    def _move_channels(self,step):
        """Absolute position; Kodi's native list movement is never applied twice."""
        if not self.visible_channels: return False
        previous=self._highlight['channels']
        target=min(max(previous+step,0),len(self.visible_channels)-1)
        self._highlight['channels']=target
        self._scroll_to_current=False
        if not self._page_start<=target<self._page_start+CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE:
            self._render()
        else:
            self.control.selectItem(target-self._page_start)
            self._render_rows()
        return target!=previous

    def _page_channels(self, step):
        if len(self.visible_channels)<=CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE: return False
        return self._move_channels(step*CHANNEL_PAGE_SIZE)

    def _focus_playing_channel(self):
        from tv_focus import target
        from playback_exit import identity
        try:owned=identity(xbmc.Player())
        except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):owned=None
        sid=owned[1]['sid'] if owned and owned[0]=='live' and owned[1]['pid']==str(self.portal['id']) else ''
        self.category_id,position,found=target(self.portal,self.index,self.enabled,sid)
        self._highlight['channels']=position;self._scroll_to_current=False;self._list_key=None
        trace('focus','CURRENT_CHANNEL',count=position,focused=found)

    def _switch(self, mode):
        self.mode = mode
        self._info_deadline = time.monotonic()+self._info_timeout if mode=='info' else None
        self._render()
        from live_timing import visible
        visible(self)

    def _toggle(self):
        """Menu opens explicit checkbox management, never toggles a nav row."""
        if self.mode!='groups': return
        from group_selection import choose_groups,enabled_ids
        if not choose_groups(self.portal,'live',categories=self.groups,allow_refresh=False): return
        self.enabled=enabled_ids(self.portal['id'],'live',self.groups)
        self._catalog_ready=False
        from live_catalog import prepare
        self._catalog_future39=prepare(self.portal,self.xc,force=True)
        self._load_catalog_from_disk()
        if self.category_id!='*' and self.category_id not in self.enabled:
            self.category_id=__import__('tv_focus').target(self.portal,self.index,self.enabled)[0]
        self._highlight['groups']=0
        self._highlight['channels']=0
        self._scroll_to_current=False
        self._list_key=None
        self._render()

    def _select(self):
        if self.mode == 'groups':
            i = self.control.getSelectedPosition()
            if 0 <= i < len(self.rows):
                cid, _, active = self.rows[i]
                if not active: return
                self.category_id = cid
                __import__('live_group93').selected(self)
                self._scroll_to_current = False
                self._highlight['channels'] = 0
                self._switch('channels')
        elif self.mode == 'guide':
            i = self.control.getSelectedPosition()
            if 0<=i<len(self._programme_events):
                event=self._programme_events[i]
                from programme_window46 import request
                request(self,self.index.by_sid.get(self._guide_sid),event)
        elif self.mode == 'channels':
            row = self.control.getSelectedPosition()
            i = self._page_start + row - self._row_offset
            if 0 <= i < len(self.visible_channels):
                c = self.visible_channels[i]
                self._highlight[self.mode] = i
                self._tune(c)

    def _tune(self, channel):
        from exit_jobs import blocked
        if blocked():return
        from player import build_playable_item
        sid = str(channel.extra.get('stream_id', ''))
        if not sid:
            return
        if self.sid != sid:
            self._recent_sid = self.sid
            self._tune_deadline = time.monotonic() + 8
        self.sid = sid
        current = self.index.by_sid.get(sid)
        self._guide.request([current] if current else [])
        self._scroll_to_current = True
        self._previous_session=session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
        session=announce(self.portal['id'], sid, channel.name)
        self._switch('hidden')
        item = build_playable_item(channel.url, title=channel.name, logo=channel.logo,live67=True)
        from live_recovery import tag_live_item
        trace('session','ITEM_TAGGED' if tag_live_item(item,session) else 'ITEM_TAG_UNAVAILABLE',marker=True)
        xbmc.Player().play(item.getPath(), item)

    def _zap(self, step):
        rows,positions = self.index.selection(self.category_id,self.enabled)
        pos = (positions[self.sid]+step)%len(rows) if self.sid in positions else (0 if step>0 else -1)
        channel = rows[pos] if rows else None
        if channel is None:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',
                'Keine aktiven Sender in dieser Gruppe.')
            return
        self._tune(channel)

    def _seek(self, seconds):
        if not self._can_seek(): return
        player = xbmc.Player()
        try:
            duration = float(player.getTotalTime())
            position = float(player.getTime())
            if not math.isfinite(position):
                raise ValueError('live stream without timeshift')
            player.seekTime(duration if seconds is None else min(max(position+seconds, 0), duration))
        except Exception:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate',
                'Spulen ist bei diesem Live-Sender nicht verfügbar (kein Timeshift).')

    def _epg(self):
        self._guide_return = self.mode if self.mode != 'guide' else getattr(self,'_guide_return','extras')
        self._guide_sid = self.sid
        self._highlight['guide'] = 0
        self._switch('guide')

    def _execute(self, section, index):
        if section == 'controls':
            if index in (1,2,5) and not self._can_seek(): return
            if index == 4:
                self._switch('extras')
                return
            if index == 0:
                if not xbmc.getCondVisibility('Player.PauseEnabled') or not self.owns_playback():return
                xbmc.Player().pause()
            elif index == 1: self._seek(-10)
            elif index == 2: self._seek(30)
            elif index == 5: self._seek(None)
            elif index == 3:
                self._request_exit('USER_STOP')
                return
            self._render()
        else:
            if index == 3:
                from live_guide_navigation import request
                request(self)
                return
            if index == 5:
                self._switch('groups')
                return
            self._switch('hidden')
            if index in (0,1,2):
                window=('osdaudiosettings','osdvideosettings','osdsubtitlesettings')[index]
                xbmc.executebuiltin('ActivateWindow('+window+')')
            elif index==6:
                __import__('stream_details').present(self._stream_details.read(xbmc.Player(),getattr(self,'_owned_token',None)))
            elif index == 4:
                import xbmcaddon
                xbmcaddon.Addon().openSettings()

    def _recent(self):
        channel = self.index.by_sid.get(self._recent_sid)
        if channel is not None:
            self._tune(channel)
        else:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate', 'Noch kein vorheriger Sender.')

    def _search_channels(self):
        """Only cached channel names; no portal access or network requests."""
        query = xbmcgui.Dialog().input('XCMate – Sender suchen')
        if not query:
            return
        choices = channels_for_category(self.channels, '*', self.enabled)
        result = next((ch for ch in choices if query.casefold() in ch.name.casefold()), None)
        if result is None:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().notification('XCMate', 'Kein passender Sender gefunden.')
            return
        self.category_id = str(result.extra.get('category_id') or '*')
        self._scroll_to_current = False
        self._highlight['channels'] = next((i for i,c in enumerate(
            channels_for_category(self.channels, self.category_id, self.enabled))
            if str(c.extra.get('stream_id')) == str(result.extra.get('stream_id'))), 0)
        self._switch('channels')

    def _input_trace(self, code, source, command='', before=None, **fields):
        try: focus_id=self.getFocusId()
        except (RuntimeError, AttributeError): focus_id=-1
        counts=getattr(self,'_left_counts',{})
        if code=='COMMAND_HANDLED' and source=='native' and fields.get('action_id')==ACTION_LEFT:
            counts['left_received']=counts.get('left_received',0)+1
            if before in ('hidden','info') and self.mode=='channels':
                counts['left_channels']=counts.get('left_channels',0)+1
            elif before=='channels' and self.mode=='groups':
                counts['left_groups']=counts.get('left_groups',0)+1
        trace('input',code,input_source=source,command=command,
              mode_before=before or self.mode,mode_after=self.mode,focus_id=focus_id,
              learned_left_action=getattr(self,'_bindings',{}).get('left',ACTION_LEFT),**counts,**fields)

    def handle_command(self, command, source='bridge', **fields):
        from live_timing import remote
        remote(self,command)
        before=self.mode
        try: fields['focus_before']=self.getFocusId()
        except (RuntimeError,AttributeError): pass
        if not self._accept_input():
            self._input_trace('COMMAND_REJECTED',source,command,before,**fields)
            return
        self._handle_command(command)
        self._input_trace('COMMAND_HANDLED',source,command,before,**fields)
        from ui_latency39 import mark,finish
        mark(self,'GUI_APPLIED');finish(self)

    def _handle_command(self, command):
        """XCMate-local TV commands; never open Kodi's own player OSD."""
        self._intro_deadline = None
        if self.mode in ('nav_icons','nav_expanded'):
            rail_mode86=self.mode
            if self._nav_rail.command(command):
                if self._nav_rail.active and self.mode==rail_mode86:self.mode='nav_expanded' if self._nav_rail.expanded else 'nav_icons'
                return
        if self.mode=='channels' and self._mini.command(command):return
        if self.mode=='info': self._info_deadline=time.monotonic()+self._info_timeout
        if command in ('left', 'long_left'):
            if self.mode in ('controls', 'extras'):
                if self.mode == 'controls':
                    self._focus_main = self._main_indices[(self._main_indices.index(self._focus_main)-1)%len(self._main_indices)]
                else:
                    self._focus_extra = (self._focus_extra - 1) % len(self.extra_buttons)
                self._render()
            elif self.mode == 'channels':
                self._switch('groups')
            elif self.mode == 'groups':
                self._switch('nav_icons')
            else:
                if self.mode in ('hidden','info'):self._focus_playing_channel()
                self._switch('channels')
        elif command == 'right':
            if self.mode == 'hidden':
                self._recent()
            elif self.mode == 'groups':
                self._switch('channels')
            elif self.mode=='channels':
                self._mini.focus()
            elif self.mode=='guide':self._switch('hidden')
            elif self.mode in ('controls','extras'):
                if self.mode == 'controls':
                    self._focus_main = self._main_indices[(self._main_indices.index(self._focus_main)+1)%len(self._main_indices)]
                else:
                    self._focus_extra = (self._focus_extra + 1) % len(self.extra_buttons)
                self._render()
        elif command in ('more', 'long_ok', 'menu', 'long_menu'):
            if command == 'menu' and self.mode == 'groups':
                self._toggle()
            elif command == 'long_menu':
                self._epg()
            else:
                self._switch('extras')
        elif command in ('epg', 'guide'):
            self._epg()
        elif command in ('info', 'long_right'):
            self._switch('info')
        elif command in ('back',):
            if self.mode == 'hidden':
                self._request_exit()
            elif self.mode == 'channels':
                self._switch('hidden')
            elif self.mode == 'guide':
                self._switch(self._guide_return)
            elif self.mode == 'groups':
                self._switch('channels')
            elif self.mode == 'extras':
                self._switch('controls')
            elif self.mode == 'controls':
                self._switch('info')
            else:
                self._switch('hidden')
        elif command == 'long_back':
            self._request_exit()
        elif command == 'long_up':
            self._recent()
        elif command == 'long_down':
            self._search_channels()
        elif command == 'long_play_pause':
            self._seek(None)
        elif command == 'play_pause':
            if xbmc.getCondVisibility('Player.PauseEnabled') and self.owns_playback():xbmc.Player().pause()
        elif command in ('up', 'down'):
            if self.mode == 'hidden':
                self._zap(1 if command == 'up' else -1)
            elif self.mode=='info':
                if command=='down': self._switch('controls')
                else: self._switch('hidden')
            elif self.mode in ('channels', 'groups', 'guide'):
                self._position(-1 if command == 'up' else 1)
            elif self.mode in ('controls','extras'):
                if self.mode=='controls': self._switch('info' if command=='up' else 'extras')
                elif command=='up': self._switch('controls')
        elif command == 'ok':
            if self.mode == 'hidden':
                self._switch('info')
            elif self.mode=='info':
                self._focus_main=0
                self._switch('controls')
            elif self.mode == 'controls':
                self._execute('controls', self._focus_main)
            elif self.mode == 'extras':
                self._execute('extras', self._focus_extra)
            else:
                self._select()

    def onAction(self, action):
        from ui_latency39 import begin
        begin(self,action.getId())
        """Native Kodi Android actions take priority while our dialog owns focus.

        Log numeric action/buttoncode only; never include stream URLs.
        The keymap bridge is a fallback, not the sole remote input path.
        """
        key = int(action.getId())
        try:
            raw = int(action.getButtonCode())
        except Exception:
            raw = 0
        if key==ACTION_STOP and not self._closed and not getattr(self,'_exiting',False):
            self._request_exit('USER_STOP');return
        if key in BACK_ACTIONS and getattr(self,'_guide_handoff',False):
            from live_guide_navigation import cancel_pending
            if cancel_pending(self):return
        was_closed=getattr(self,'_closed',False)
        if not self._accept_input():
            trace('input','ACTION_IGNORED_CLOSED' if was_closed else 'ACTION_REJECTED',
                  action_id=key,button_code=raw)
            return
        self._intro_deadline = None
        marker = xbmcgui.Window(10000)
        marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.LastRemoteKey', '{} / {} (native)'.format(key, raw))
        marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.AutoPopupStatus',
                           'natives Action-Event empfangen')
        try:
            count = int(marker.getProperty('XtreamMate.NativeActionCount') or '0')
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            count = 0
        marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.NativeActionCount', str(count+1))
        self._input_trace('NATIVE_ACTION','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw,count=count+1)
        # Back and Context are *not* Kodi player OSD commands in XCMate.
        # Must override learned Back->left and default Menu->epg from old profiles.
        if key in BACK_ACTIONS:
            mapped = 'back'
        elif key == ACTION_CONTEXT_MENU:
            mapped = 'menu'
        elif key == ACTION_PAUSE:
            mapped = 'play_pause'
        elif key == ACTION_RIGHT:
            mapped = 'right'
        elif key == ACTION_LEFT:
            mapped = 'left'
        elif key in (ACTION_UP,ACTION_DOWN) and self.mode=='channels' and self._mini.focused:
            self._mini.command('up' if key==ACTION_UP else 'down',native=True);return
        elif key in (ACTION_UP, ACTION_DOWN, ACTION_PAGE_UP, ACTION_PAGE_DOWN) and self.mode in ('channels', 'guide', 'groups'):
            # CGUIControlList already applied this action before onAction.
            if key in (ACTION_UP,ACTION_DOWN) and self.mode=='channels':
                self._move_channels(-1 if key==ACTION_UP else 1)
                self._input_trace('NATIVE_LIST_MOVED','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)
                return
            elif key in (ACTION_PAGE_UP, ACTION_PAGE_DOWN) and self.mode == 'channels':
                if not self._page_channels(-1 if key == ACTION_PAGE_UP else 1):
                    self._remember_position()
            else:
                self._remember_position()
            self._render_rows()
            self._input_trace('NATIVE_LIST_MOVED','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)
            return
        elif key == ACTION_SELECT:
            # Omega dispatches onControl BEFORE onAction(SELECT). Handling
            # SELECT here too would execute a second action in the new mode.
            marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.LastHandledKey', 'ok')
            self._input_trace('SELECT_ALREADY_CLICKED','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)
            return
        elif key in (ACTION_UP, ACTION_DOWN):
            mapped = 'up' if key==ACTION_UP else 'down'
        else:
            from remote_profiles import mapped_action
            mapped = mapped_action(key, self._bindings)
        if mapped:
            marker.setProperty('XtreamMate.LastHandledKey', mapped)
            self.handle_command(mapped,source='native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)
        else:
            self._input_trace('ACTION_UNMAPPED','native',action_id=key,button_code=raw)

    def onControl(self, control):
        """Omega's click callback for programmatically created controls."""
        if not self._accept_input() or not self._drawn:
            return
        control_id = control.getId()
        if self._nav_rail.click(control_id):return
        if self.mode=='channels' and control_id==self._mini.list.getId():
            self._mini.focused=True;self._mini.selected=max(0,self._mini.list.getSelectedPosition());self._mini.command('ok');return
        if control_id == self.capture.getId():
            self.handle_command('ok',source='control',control_id=control_id)
            return
        if control_id == self.control.getId() and self.mode in ('groups','channels','guide'):
            self.handle_command('ok',source='control',control_id=control_id)
            return
        if self.mode == 'controls':
            for i,button in enumerate(self.main_buttons):
                if button.getId() == control_id:
                    if i not in self._main_indices: return
                    self._focus_main=i
                    self.handle_command('ok',source='control',control_id=control_id)
                    return
        elif self.mode == 'extras':
            for i,button in enumerate(self.extra_buttons):
                if button.getId() == control_id:
                    self._focus_extra=i
                    self.handle_command('ok',source='control',control_id=control_id)
                    return


def start_if_eligible(last_nonce):
    """Return overlay instance or None. Called in the service's main thread."""
    if not xbmc.Player().isPlayingVideo():
        return None
    session = session_from_property(xbmcgui.Window(10000).getProperty(SESSION_KEY))
    if not session or session['nonce'] == last_nonce:
        trace('dialog','NO_SESSION' if not session else 'SESSION_ALREADY_HANDLED',marker=bool(session))
        return None
    from portals import get_by_id
    portal = get_by_id(session['pid'])
    if not portal or portal.get('type') != 'xtream' or not portal.get('enabled',True):
        trace('dialog','PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE',marker=True)
        return None
    try:
        candidate = LiveNavigator(portal, session['sid'])
        trace('dialog','CANDIDATE_CREATED',channels=len(candidate.channels),catalog=candidate._catalog_ready)
        if candidate.owns_playback(): return candidate
        candidate.close()
        return None
    except Exception as exc:
        trace('dialog','CONSTRUCTION_FAILED')
        warn('XCMate navigator cannot start: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
        return None

"""Build immutable channel/index models in the existing catalog worker."""
import time


def trace(portal,code,rows=0):
    if code not in ('LOCAL_READ_BEGIN','START_GROUP_MODEL_READY','FULL_MODEL_READY'):
        return
    from flow46 import read
    value=read()
    if not value or value.get('kind')!='live' or value.get('pid')!=str(portal['id']):
        return
    import xbmc
    try:
        xbmc.log('[XCMate][PREPARE47] id='+value['id']+' code='+code+' rows='+str(rows)+
                 ' ms='+str(max(0,(time.monotonic_ns()-value['start'])//1000000)),xbmc.LOGINFO)
    except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):
        pass


def model(portal,client,categories,streams):
    from iptv import Channel
    from tv_data import CatalogIndex
    from group_selection import enabled_ids
    groups=[g for g in categories if isinstance(g,dict)]
    names={str(g.get('category_id')):g.get('category_name','') for g in groups}
    channels=[]
    for stream in streams:
        if not isinstance(stream,dict) or not stream.get('stream_id'):
            continue
        cid=str(stream.get('category_id',''))
        channels.append(Channel(name=stream.get('name',''),
            url=client.live_stream_url(stream['stream_id'],__import__('live_format67').extension()),logo=stream.get('stream_icon',''),
            group=str(names.get(cid,cid)),tvg_id=str(stream.get('epg_channel_id') or ''),
            extra={'category_id':cid,'stream_id':str(stream['stream_id'])}))
    enabled=enabled_ids(portal['id'],'live',groups)
    index=CatalogIndex(channels)
    index.selection('*',enabled)
    return dict(groups=groups,channels=channels,enabled=enabled,index=index)

worker; aliases and programmes are read in one SQLite transaction.
"""

def channel_keys(channel, mappings):

def _now_next89(pid,channels,mappings,now=None,client=None,display_only65=False):
    """Bounded local batch, including strictly cache-only short-EPG fallback."""
    from epg_views import resolve_guide
    ts=time.time() if now is None else now
    from epg_handoff63 import get as warm63,remember as remember63,note as note63,register as register63
    from epg_status import revision as revision63
    revision_before63=revision63(pid)
    if display_only65 and channels:
        prepared74={channel_keys(c,mappings)[0]:warm63(pid,channel_keys(c,mappings)[0],now=ts,mappings=mappings) for c in channels[:16]}
        if prepared74 and all(v and 0<=time.time()-v.get('_published_at63',0)<15 for v in prepared74.values()) and revision63(pid)==revision_before63:
            return prepared74
    from epg_poll77 import key as poll_key77,read as poll_read77,remember as poll_remember77
    cache_key77=poll_key77(pid,channels,mappings,display_only65)
    cached77=poll_read77(cache_key77,ts)
